architecture.cold_path: single geometry-conditioned model predicts full two-port z0 and air decomposition; no PortSelf/ColdRes/ColdResPose/MutFix chain
architecture.source_model: SrcFix retained as independent spatial Joule-source output

sampling.inference_domain: core only plus validation-calibrated nearest-neighbour coverage threshold
sampling.boundary_rule: 1-2 parameters in outer 5% of global range
sampling.extreme_rule: 3 or more parameters in outer 5% of global range

acceptance.static_test: 226 unique geometries; report overall and by core/boundary/extreme
acceptance.domain: calibrate from core validation samples; boundary/extreme rejected for default inference
acceptance.dynamic: frozen rank48 thermal model on six unseen geometries and twelve histories; report only domain-accepted core cases for formal deployment metrics
acceptance.promotion: require static cold, in-domain dynamic, temperature and energy-budget improvement; retain V5 baseline until passed
